```{r} #| results: asis resources <- withCallingHandlers( read.csv("resources.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8", na.strings = character()), warning = function(w) stop(conditionMessage(w), call. = FALSE) ) stopifnot(all(c("Topics", "Format") %in% names(resources))) escape <- function(x) { x <- gsub("&", "&", x, fixed = TRUE) x <- gsub("<", "<", x, fixed = TRUE) x <- gsub(">", ">", x, fixed = TRUE) gsub('"', """, x, fixed = TRUE) } category_counts <- function(values) { parts <- lapply(strsplit(ifelse(is.na(values), "", values), ";", fixed = TRUE), function(x) unique(trimws(x))) all <- unlist(parts) sort(table(all[nzchar(all)]), decreasing = TRUE) } topics <- category_counts(resources$Topics) formats <- category_counts(resources$Format) icons <- c( "article / book" = '', "report" = '', "video" = '', "podcast" = '', "website" = '', "art" = '', "museum / exhibit" = '', "infographic" = '', "map" = '', "indigenous science" = '', "california native history" = '', "indigenous education" = '', "decolonization" = '', "tribal university partnerships" = '' ) icon <- function(label) { path <- icons[tolower(label)] if (is.na(path)) path <- icons["report"] paste0('') } descriptions <- c( "California Native History" = "Regional histories and Indigenous perspectives.", "Indigenous Education" = "Scholarship on science education and land-based learning.", "Decolonization" = "Introductory talks, reflections and critical perspectives.", "Indigenous Science" = "Indigenous knowledge systems, science and environmental stewardship.", "Tribal University Partnerships" = "Relationships and collaboration between Tribal communities and universities." ) cat('

Learning · Teaching · Relationships

Explore, learn, and build respectful relationships

This developing collection brings together publicly discoverable resources on Indigenous histories, education, science, and decolonization. It is intended as a starting point for educators, researchers, and community partners—not as a substitute for relationships with Indigenous communities or community-specific guidance.

Explore the resource library →

', nrow(resources), ' resources · ', length(topics), ' topics · ', length(formats), ' formats

', sep="") cat('

Explore by topic

Find a starting point for your learning.

') for (label in names(topics)) { desc <- descriptions[label] if (is.na(desc)) desc <- "Explore resources in this topic." cat('', icon(label), '

', escape(label), '

', escape(desc), '

', topics[[label]], ' resources →', sep="") } cat('

Browse by resource format

') for (label in names(formats)) { cat('', icon(label), '', escape(label), '', formats[[label]], ' resources', sep="") } cat('

Resources may appear in more than one topic or format.

') ``` ::: {.home-stewardship} This is an early prototype built from a small working inventory. Resource descriptions, categories, permissions, and the site's future direction are subject to review with the Indigenous scholars helping curate the collection.
